cards.title: Ship Weekly
cards.description: Build the habit of releasing something every single week, no matter how small. Consistency compounds faster than perfection.
cards.highlight: Small releases every week beat big launches once a year.

cards.title: Read 24 Books
cards.description: Two books a month across technical, biography, and fiction categories. Tracking every title, rating, and key takeaway.
cards.highlight: Two books a month changes how you think.

cards.title: Launch a SaaS
cards.description: Go from idea to paying customers before the year ends. Documenting every step from validation to first revenue milestone.
cards.highlight: First dollar is the hardest. Everything after is a system.

cards.title: Run a Half Marathon
cards.description: Twelve weeks of structured training, three runs per week, building from 5K to 21K. Week-by-week progress logged.
cards.highlight: The finish line starts at week one.

cards.title: Master TypeScript
cards.description: Go beyond basic types — generics, conditional types, mapped types, and building a fully typed SDK from scratch.
cards.highlight: Real TypeScript mastery lives in the advanced types.

cards.title: Save Six Months Emergency Fund
cards.description: Building a financial buffer with automated transfers, expense audits, and a clear monthly milestone dashboard.
cards.highlight: Financial freedom starts with six months of runway.

cards.title: Write in Public
cards.description: Publish one article per week for a full year. Raw drafts, half-formed ideas, and finished essays — all out in the open.
cards.highlight: Fifty-two articles. One year. No excuses.

cards.title: Learn Spanish to B2
cards.description: Daily thirty-minute sessions combining Anki, italki tutors, and immersion content targeting conversational fluency.
cards.highlight: Thirty minutes a day is enough to become fluent.

cards.title: Reach 10K Followers
cards.description: Growing an audience by sharing genuine work, behind-the-scenes process, and hard-won lessons without chasing algorithms.
cards.highlight: Build an audience by being genuinely useful.

cards.title: Sleep Eight Hours
cards.description: Fixing sleep as the foundation for everything else — tracking, wind-down routines, light exposure, and cutting caffeine after noon.
cards.highlight: Everything gets easier when you stop being tired.

cards.title: Build in Public
cards.description: Document every decision, mistake, and milestone of a real product build — revenue numbers, churn, pivots, and all.
cards.highlight: Radical transparency builds faster than stealth.

cards.title: Zero Inbox by Friday
cards.description: A sustainable email system using filters, templates, and a strict processing routine that keeps the inbox at zero every week.
cards.highlight: An empty inbox is a clear mind.
